# Code of Conduct

Ushka is built in the open, and everyone taking part is expected to treat the others
with respect. This applies to the repositories, issue trackers, pull requests, any
chat or discussion space, and any event run under the project's name.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful and inclusive, whatever a person's background or experience.
- Be patient with newcomers and with slow replies. Maintainers work in their own time.
- Disagree about ideas, not about people. Keep the tone professional.
- Keep discussions on topic, and keep the issue tracker for the work on Ushka.
- Give and accept constructive feedback.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Threats or violent language.
- Discriminatory jokes or language.
- Sexually explicit or violent material, and unwelcome sexual attention.
- Publishing or threatening to publish someone's private information.
- Personal insults, including about someone's technical ability.
- Repeated harassment. If someone asks you to stop, stop.
- Encouraging any of the above.

## Reporting

Write to [kleber.code@gmail.com](mailto:kleber.code@gmail.com). Every report is reviewed and
handled promptly and fairly, and the reporter's privacy is respected.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may take any action they consider appropriate, from a warning to a
temporary or permanent ban.

## Attribution
